findings.title: Record monotonic time before safety and neutral-reset early returns
findings.detail: Actual OwnControls accepts a 5s lease at local1000; Finish1100=true, Stop6001=true intentionally survives TTL, then Finish2000=true after wall-clock rewind. allowed() only updates its high-water time through fresh() on the ordinary path. Safety/neutral-reset early returns do not consume observed time, so the same expired ordinary metadata can revive. POST remains authoritative; this is a display/callback freshness defect, not a reproduced server authorization bypass.
findings.required_fix: Consume finite now into monotonic high-water time on every time-bearing entry before early returns; regression expiry→safety/neutral-reset→rewind must deny ordinary actions while preserving confirmed safety.
findings.interim_observation: During ongoing author writes, a separate clock-current probe on SHA941968339143cb178c8ca3b1c06a0cb5a89d2027214b2e51369d300108596a50 returned finish_after_rewind=false. This is a narrow intermediate corrected observation, not final independent acceptance; original failing input/result preserved.

findings.title: Fence the authenticated session deadline after the final awaited access read
findings.detail: Actual Rooms.access/Rooms.auth and Games.dispatchSelfActions with explicit SQL-return doubles: sessionexpires7000, grant/member SQL parameters evaluated at1000, final awaited currentAcceptance advances clock to8000. The final presence checks still pass (<45s), then recipient metadata is enqueued with Finish=true and expiry13000 despite expired authentication. Auth returns no session expiry, so final synchronous now cannot compare or cap it. Both source methods are real; SQL/transaction/current/snapshot/present seams are explicit doubles. This does not claim a real PostgreSQL wait or browser exploit.
findings.required_fix: Return an authenticated grant expiry from actual session-row reads; after all awaited policy/access reads, enforce current authenticated deadline synchronously before any enqueue (including safety metadata) and bound emitted lease. Authentication failure must not become degraded-safety metadata; retain intended acceptance/catalog failure safety semantics. Add actual PG/HTTP last-read wait crossing authentication expiry, then fresh independent retest.
